documents.text: Aducanumab: US status (FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)) is 'Approved'. EU status (EMA (European Medicines Agency)) is 'Application withdrawn'. This EU authorisation was granted via the EMA's centralised procedure. Its ATC classification is N07.

Lecanemab: US status (FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)) is 'Approved'. EU status (EMA (European Medicines Agency)) is 'Authorised'. This EU authorisation was granted via the EMA's centralised procedure. Its ATC classification is N06DX04.

Donanemab: US status (FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)) is 'Approved'. EU status (EMA (European Medicines Agency)) is 'Authorised'. This EU authorisation was granted via the EMA's centralised procedure. Its ATC classification is N06DX05.

Niraparib: US status (FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)) is 'Approved'. EU status (EMA (European Medicines Agency)) is 'Authorised'. This EU authorisation was granted via the EMA's centralised procedure. Its ATC classification is L01XK02. It holds an EMA orphan-medicine designation.

Isatuximab: US status (FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)) is 'Approved'. EU status (EMA (European Medicines Agency)) is 'Authorised'. This EU authorisation was granted via the EMA's centralised procedure. Its ATC classification is L01XC38.

Epcoritamab: US status (FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)) is 'Approved'. EU status (EMA (European Medicines Agency)) is 'Authorised'. This EU authorisation was granted via the EMA's centralised procedure. Its ATC classification is L01FX27.

Dostarlimab: US status (FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)) is 'Approved'. EU status (EMA (European Medicines Agency)) is 'Authorised'. This EU authorisation was granted via the EMA's centralised procedure. Its ATC classification is L01FF07.

Melphalan flufenamide: US status (FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration)) is 'Approved (2021), then withdrawn (February 2024) — no longer in the current FDA index'. EU status (EMA (European Medicines Agency)) is 'Authorised'. This EU authorisation was granted via the EMA's centralised procedure. Its ATC classification is L01AA10.
